rules.title: AWS Lambda Node.js 14 runtime is end-of-life
rules.summary: The AWS Lambda runtimes table lists nodejs14.x under Deprecated runtimes with deprecation date 2023-12-04. AWS no longer applies security or other updates to that managed runtime.

constraints: Keep provider.runtime, Globals.Function.Runtime, per-function Runtime, and Terraform aws_lambda_function.runtime on one AWS Lambda runtime identifier that AWS still supports.
Raising the managed runtime can require Node.js language and dependency changes; confirm handlers and native modules run on the replacement before deploying.

steps.title: Raise the AWS Lambda runtime
steps.instructions: Change the reported Runtime (or provider.runtime / terraform runtime) from nodejs14.x to a supported AWS Lambda Node.js identifier (see the replacement).

steps.title: Align other runtime surfaces
steps.instructions: Update every other SAM/CloudFormation Globals or function Runtime, serverless.yml provider or function runtime, Terraform aws_lambda_function.runtime, and CI deploy config that still pins nodejs14.x.

verification.command: sam validate || serverless print || terraform validate
verification.purpose: Validate the updated SAM, Serverless Framework, or Terraform declaration before deploy.

steps.instructions: Update every other SAM/CloudFormation Globals or function Runtime, serverless.yml provider or function runtime, Terraform aws_lambda_function.runtime, and CI deploy config that still pins dotnetcore2.0.

verification.command: sam validate || serverless print || terraform validate
verification.purpose: Validate the updated SAM, Serverless Framework, or Terraform declaration before deploy.

rules.title: AWS Lambda Node.js 0.10 runtime is end-of-life
rules.summary: The AWS Lambda runtimes table lists nodejs under Deprecated runtimes with deprecation date 2016-08-30. AWS no longer applies security or other updates to that managed runtime.

constraints: Keep provider.runtime, Globals.Function.Runtime, per-function Runtime, and Terraform aws_lambda_function.runtime on one AWS Lambda runtime identifier that AWS still supports.
Raising the managed runtime can require Node.js language and dependency changes; confirm handlers and native modules run on the replacement before deploying.

steps.title: Raise the AWS Lambda runtime
steps.instructions: Change the reported Runtime (or provider.runtime / terraform runtime) from nodejs to a supported AWS Lambda Node.js identifier (see the replacement).

steps.title: Align other runtime surfaces
steps.instructions: Update every other SAM/CloudFormation Globals or function Runtime, serverless.yml provider or function runtime, Terraform aws_lambda_function.runtime, and CI deploy config that still pins nodejs.

verification.command: sam validate || serverless print || terraform validate
verification.purpose: Validate the updated SAM, Serverless Framework, or Terraform declaration before deploy.

rules.title: Google Cloud Functions Node.js 14 runtime is end-of-life
rules.summary: The Google Cloud Functions runtime support schedule lists Node.js 14 (runtime ID nodejs14) as deprecated on 2024-01-30 and decommissioned on 2025-01-30. Google no longer provides maintenance for that runtime.

constraints: Keep Terraform google_cloudfunctions*_function runtime (and any matching deploy config) on one Google Cloud Functions runtime ID that Google still supports.
Raising the managed runtime can require Node.js language and dependency changes; confirm handlers run on the replacement before deploying.

steps.title: Raise the Google Cloud Functions runtime
steps.instructions: Change the reported runtime from nodejs14 to a supported Google Cloud Functions Node.js runtime ID (see the replacement).

steps.title: Align other runtime surfaces
steps.instructions: Update every other Terraform google_cloudfunctions*_function runtime and CI deploy config that still pins nodejs14.

verification.command: terraform validate
verification.purpose: Validate the updated Terraform google_cloudfunctions*_function declaration before deploy.
